newsitem.title: UK: Blue Circle seeks contamination damages - FT.
newsitem.headline: Blue Circle seeks contamination damages - FT.

text.p: UK cement manufacturer Blue Circle is seeking millions of pounds of damages against the Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE), part of the Ministry of Defence, for allegedly contaminating its land with radioactive material, the Financial Times said in its Wednesday edition.
The FT said Blue Circle alleges that part of its 137 acre site at Aldermaston was contaminated when two artificial ponds containing radioactive water overflowed during a storm in 1989.

The AWE is responsible for manufacturing the Trident nuclear warhead and has its site next to Blue Circle's land. The company claims it has been unable to sell the site and is claiming damages of between 8.0 million and 10.0 million stg. A court hearing on the claim was adjourned to Thursday, the FT said.
